footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to PPL: after $2.0M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 6.9% to $9.0B in 2025. Operating income rose 22.4% to $2.1B, a 23.5% margin.
Net income rose 33.1% to $1.2B, or $1.59 per share. Operating cash flow was $2.6B and free cash flow −$1.4B, versus −$465M; PPL returned $794M through dividends.
sources: PPL Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
